ApplyBody.description: Carry the optional preset instructions for ``POST /api/config/apply`` — both fields absent applies the buffer.
ApplyBody.title: ApplyBody

AutosaveBody.description: Carry the on/off flag ``POST /api/autosave`` sets on the preset store.
AutosaveBody.title: AutosaveBody

DescriptionBody.description:
One profile's description for ``PUT /api/descriptions``.

A sibling surface keeps its own body (``models`` is the main surface's). Empty text is a legal body and means the
user cleared the description — the store turns that into a removal.
DescriptionBody.title: DescriptionBody

DropBody.description:
Entries to REMOVE from the staged buffer, named rather than valued.

The client sends these for edits that have returned to their baseline: the value is no longer a change, so it must
not ride along on the next apply and restart the daemon for nothing. `live` names arguments within a live key;
`http` names whole fields.
DropBody.title: DropBody

EngineBody.description:
Carry the hardware-accel attribute overrides for ``POST /api/engine``.

``all_presets`` writes them into every snapshot in the backup archive instead of only the active preset's.
EngineBody.title: EngineBody

FavoritesBody.description:
The starred names for ``PUT /api/favorites`` — the filter set, the modulator set, or both.

A sibling surface keeps its own body (``models`` is the main surface's). Each field the body carries is the whole
set the client wants stored for that kind, not a diff against the set it last read. A field the body omits is left
alone: absent means "not part of this write", never "empty it", so a client that knows only about filters cannot
wipe the modulator stars.
FavoritesBody.title: FavoritesBody

LiveBody.description: Carry the live config-form field/value pairs ``POST /api/config/live`` writes immediately.
LiveBody.title: LiveBody

MatrixModeBody.description:
One preset's Matrix-tab mode for ``PUT /api/matrixmodes``.

A sibling surface keeps its own body (``models`` is the main surface's). The mode is validated by the store rather
than by the type, so an unknown value answers 422 naming what is storable instead of a schema complaint.
MatrixModeBody.title: MatrixModeBody

MatrixProfileBody.description: Carry the verb and profile name for ``POST /api/matrix/profile``, the live matrix-profile switch.
MatrixProfileBody.title: MatrixProfileBody

NarrowingBody.description:
The whole facet set for ``PUT /api/narrowing``.

Deliberately untyped per facet: the store owns the domains, so a bad token comes back as its sentence naming the
facet rather than as pydantic's shape complaint about a dict.
NarrowingBody.title: NarrowingBody

ProfileBody.description: Carry the preset name ``POST /api/profile/{action}`` loads, saves, or deletes.
ProfileBody.title: ProfileBody

SaveBody.description: Which settings ``PUT /api/livepresets/{name}`` stores; None keeps everything the engine reports.
SaveBody.title: SaveBody

SaveTarget.description: Name the preset a successful apply persists into — nested under ``ApplyBody.save``.
SaveTarget.title: SaveTarget

SpeakersBody.description: Carry the speaker-processing switch and per-channel level/distance values for ``POST /api/speakers``.
SpeakersBody.title: SpeakersBody

StageBody.description:
Carry one staging request's additions and removals for ``POST /api/config/stage``.

``live`` and ``http`` merge into the buffer; ``drop`` is applied afterwards, so one request can both re-stage a
field and report another clean.
StageBody.title: StageBody

VolumeBody.description: Carry the playback-volume level ``POST /api/volume`` writes to the live lane.
VolumeBody.title: VolumeBody

get.description: Return the last ``limit`` audit records, newest last, read straight off the log file.

schema.title: Limit
Response Records Api Audit Get

get.description:
Auto-pilot's state.

409 when the store on disk is stamped newer than this HQPTuner reads — reporting "off" would be a lie about a file
that is there and full.

schema.title: Response Autopilot Api Autopilot Get

post.description:
Switch auto-pilot on or off, and answer with the state that was stored.

Neither direction reads the engine: what is engaged when the switch is flipped has no bearing on what auto-pilot
does next.

schema.title: Response Set Autopilot Api Autopilot Post

post.description:
Toggle auto-save: every successful apply/live write is folded back into the active preset's store file.

Pure store flag — no daemon touch.

schema.title: Response Set Autosave Api Autosave Post

get.description:
Return the daemon's settings archive as a zip download, carrying HQPTuner's profile descriptions.

The descriptions ride as one extra member (``presetzip.DESCRIPTIONS_MEMBER``) so the download is the whole of
what the user has here, not the daemon's half of it; every daemon member is copied byte-for-byte, so the archive
still restores anywhere. A store with nothing in it adds no member.

Return the /config form joined with HQPTuner's preset list, the running config, and the output device's caps.

Needs credentials — without them the 8088 lane does not exist and the route 503s.

schema.title: Response Config Api Config Get

post.description:
Write everything staged to the daemon, then persist and clear the buffer only if all of it took.

400 when nothing is staged and no preset switch was asked for. A soft failure returns the report with the buffer
intact so the user can retry; the persistent lane restarts the daemon and interrupts playback, never gated on.

schema.title: Body
Response Apply Api Config Apply Post

post.description:
Apply live-lane config-form fields immediately, readback-verified.

This is the LIVE view's whole write path. Never staged and never persistent, so it cannot restart the daemon and
cannot flush what the tabs view has staged.

Routed through the lane rather than a manager method because the LIVE lane's
only caller is this route, and `/state` already reads `routing`
directly for the same reason.

schema.title: Response Config Live Api Config Live Post

delete.description:
Throw away everything staged, recording it first, and release the filter uploads parked for it.

Touches the daemon not at all — the discarded edits were never written to it.

schema.title: Response Discard Api Config Pending Delete

get.description: Return the staged buffer as it stands, so a reloaded browser recovers what it had staged.

schema.title: Response Pending Api Config Pending Get

post.description:
Re-scan output devices on the daemon and refetch the config forms.

A device that was absent (a powered-off NAA endpoint) appears in the dropdown afterwards.

schema.title: Response Config Refresh Api Config Refresh Post

post.description:
Merge the request's edits into the staged buffer, drop what it reports clean, and return the whole buffer.

422 when a live key is not a known live setting — the daemon would have no setter to call for it. Nothing is
written to the daemon here; apply is a separate call.

schema.title: Response Stage Api Config Stage Post

get.description:
Every stored profile description, keyed by profile name.

409 when the store on disk is stamped newer than this HQPTuner reads — an empty map would be a lie about a file
that is there and full.

schema.title: Response Descriptions Api Descriptions Get

put.description:
Store one profile's description and answer with the whole map.

One profile per write rather than the whole map, unlike favorites: a description is long, two browsers editing
different profiles is ordinary, and a whole-map replace would make one of them lose the other's paragraph.

schema.title: Response Save Description Api Descriptions Put

get.description:
Return the hardware-acceleration attributes, read out of a fresh backup, and the active preset snapshot's name.

They are not on any form, so this costs a backup fetch — read on demand, never per poll.

schema.title: Response Engine Get Api Engine Get

post.description:
Write hardware-acceleration attributes by editing the backup archive and restoring it, then auto-save.

400 with no overrides, 422 when one is not a valid engine attribute. The restore restarts the daemon and
interrupts playback — the user's call, never refused for it.

schema.title: Response Engine Apply Api Engine Post

get.description:
Return the engine's enumerations merged with the static ``data/*.json`` overlay, plus the current output mode.

The running engine owns the names, IDs, and ordering; the merge only annotates them. 503 until they have loaded.

schema.title: Response Enumerations Api Enumerations Get

get.description:
Every starred filter and modulator name, each sorted.

409 when the store on disk is stamped newer than this HQPTuner reads — an empty list would be a lie about a file
that is there and full.

schema.title: Response Favorites Api Favorites Get

put.description:
Replace the sets the body carries, and answer with both stored lists.

Whole-set replace per kind: unstarring is a write without the name, so the client never needs a second route and
two browsers racing is last-write-wins rather than a merge nobody asked for. A kind the body omits is not written,
so the answer reports it as it already stood; a body naming neither kind is not a write at all and is refused
rather than answered with a silent no-op.

schema.title: Response Save Favorites Api Favorites Put

get.description:
Return daemon reachability, the current connection's age, alarm/info/license, and HQPTuner's own version.

Answers from the poll loop's cached view, so it never waits on a socket and stays useful while the daemon is down.

schema.title: Response Health Api Health Get

get.description:
Every saved live preset.

Flat: a preset carries its own output mode, so applying one taken on the other chain switches the engine to it
rather than conflicting with what is loaded — there is nothing here to gate on.

schema.title: Response Live Presets Api Livepresets Get

get.description:
Return what a save would store right now, per setting with its display name — what the save popover lists.

409 when the loaded chain is unknowable, the same refusal a save gives.

schema.title: Response Live Snapshot Api Livepresets Snapshot Get

delete.description:
Remove a saved live preset from the store, leaving the running engine untouched.

404 when no preset is saved under the name.

schema.title: Name
Response Delete Live Preset Api Livepresets  Name  Delete

put.description:
Snapshot what the engine is playing right now under this name, overwriting any preset already saved under it.

A body naming ``fields`` keeps only those settings; the rest are absent from the record and an apply leaves them
where the engine has them. 409 when the loaded chain is unknowable — the record would claim a chain it never
captured. 422 when a named field is not a live preset setting.

schema.title: Name
Body
Response Save Live Preset Api Livepresets  Name  Put

post.description:
Apply a saved preset, readback-verified.

Its output mode goes first and the rest follows against the enumerations that switch produced (``apply_preset``),
so a preset taken on the other chain applies by switching to it.

The live lane's all-or-nothing 409 carries over unchanged: a stored ID the
running enumerations no longer offer refuses the whole preset, naming the
field.

schema.title: Name
Response Apply Live Preset Api Livepresets  Name  Apply Post

get.description:
Return a static tail of the daemon's log file (System-tab live view).

Read-only, no daemon socket — reads the file the running config points at.

schema.title: Lines
Response Log Tail Api Log Get

get.description:
Return the Matrix tab's read model: the /matrix form plus the live, file-saved, and per-preset profile lists.

Served from the last-loaded form snapshot, stale-flagged when the daemon is unreachable — never a socket wait.

schema.title: Response Matrix Api Matrix Get

post.description:
Park an uploaded convolution filter (wav/txt) for the next apply, which injects it into the restore archive.

Returns the daemon-side absolute path the pipeline process string should reference (matrix-spec.md
"Filter upload").

schema.title: Response Matrix Filter Api Matrix Filter Post

post.description:
Load a saved matrix profile into the running matrix (matrix-spec.md "Profiles", amended round 5).

4321 ``MatrixSetProfile``, live, no engine reload, playback undisturbed, post-process untouched. Needs no
credentials — the Control API lane is unauthenticated.

Saving and deleting a profile are NOT here: they are staged
``<matrix_profile>`` config edits and ride ``/api/config/stage`` +
``/api/config/apply`` like every other persistent setting, because the daemon
does not persist profiles itself (round 5). The client stages the loaded
profile's rows alongside this call, so a load is live AND persists.

schema.title: Response Matrix Profile Api Matrix Profile Post

get.description:
Every stored Matrix-tab mode, keyed by preset name.

409 when the store on disk is stamped newer than this HQPTuner reads — an empty map would be a lie about a file
that is there and full, and would put the user on the wrong half of the tab.

schema.title: Response Matrix Modes Api Matrixmodes Get

put.description:
Store one preset's Matrix-tab mode and answer with the whole map.

One preset per write rather than the whole map: two browsers looking at different presets is ordinary, and a
whole-map replace would make one of them undo the other's choice.

schema.title: Response Save Matrix Mode Api Matrixmodes Put

get.description:
Return the whole static ``data/*.json`` overlay — filters, shapers, and settings prose — unjoined.

Loaded once at startup and never daemon-dependent, so this answers the same whether or not hqplayerd is up.

schema.title: Response Metadata Api Metadata Get

get.description:
Every narrow-bar facet, stored value or default.

409 when the store on disk is stamped newer than this HQPTuner reads — answering with defaults would be a lie
about a file that is there and full.

schema.title: Response Narrowing Api Narrowing Get

put.description:
Replace the whole facet set with the facets given, and answer with what was stored.

Whole-set replace: a facet left out is stored at its default, so the client never needs a second route and two
browsers racing is last-write-wins rather than a merge nobody asked for.

schema.title: Response Save Narrowing Api Narrowing Put

delete.description:
Delete a preset from the store and remove its daemon mirror.

Backs the Delete button on the preset picker.

schema.title: Name
Response Delete Preset Api Preset  Name  Delete

get.description:
Read a preset's saved settings from its snapshot without loading it.

The editor previews these when the user picks a preset, before any apply. The empty name is "(no preset)" and
previews the running config.

schema.title: Name
Response Preset Api Preset  Name  Get

post.description:
Load, save, or delete a named preset, dispatching on the path segment.

404 on an action outside those three or a name the store does not hold, 422 on an empty name.

schema.title: Action
Response Profile Api Profile  Action  Post

post.description:
Push a user-uploaded settings archive to the daemon, recording its name, size, and SHA-256 first.

The daemon self-restarts on it, interrupting playback. The one thing taken out of the archive first is
HQPTuner's own descriptions member, which ``GET /api/backup`` put there: it is folded into this install's store
and never handed to hqplayerd, which did not write it and has no idea what it is. Everything else — including a
bare XML upload, which is not an archive at all — reaches the daemon exactly as the user sent it.

schema.title: Response Restore Api Restore Post

get.description:
Speaker-processing read model (readme §1.9): enabled + per-channel level (dBFS) / distance (cm).

Served from the last-loaded form snapshot, stale-flagged when the daemon is unreachable — never a socket wait
(fail-fast, see deps).

schema.title: Response Speakers Api Speakers Get

post.description:
Apply speaker processing via the /speakers form lane (readme §1.9).

Reloads the engine (~3 s), interrupting playback — never refused for it. The write is checkbox-safe and
range-validated in ``httpconf.apply_speakers``.

schema.title: Response Speakers Apply Api Speakers Post

get.description:
Return the daemon's last State frame with the engine's active filter/shaper chain folded in.

Stale-flagged from the last-loaded copy while the daemon is unreachable; 503 until the first frame has landed.

schema.title: Response State Api State Get

get.description:
Return the Status frame with its track metadata, the advisor's recommendation, and auto-pilot's state.

503 until the first Status has landed; the recommendation is null whenever the metering reader has nothing to say.
Auto-pilot rides along because it moves in the background — its own task can switch the filter, and a page that
only asked when it last wrote would show the wrong control. An unreadable auto-pilot store reads as off here and
says so properly on ``GET /api/autopilot``, so one damaged file cannot take the whole status page down. ``metering``
says whether the reader is running at all (``HQPTUNER_METERING_ENABLED``), which is what auto-pilot's switch grays
against: a null recommendation cannot tell "nothing to report" from "nothing is reading".

schema.title: Response Status Api Status Get

get.description:
Live volume + its live bounds/enabled (VolumeRange).

Separate from the staged-config surface — this is the runtime playback-volume lane.

schema.title: Response Volume Get Api Volume Get

post.description:
Immediate live-volume write — never staged, never restarts.

503 when volume control is disabled (the slider grays on that state, so this is the race backstop).

schema.title: Response Volume Set Api Volume Post
